name: Crespi d'Adda
description: Crespi d'Adda is a small village in Lombardy, in the province of Bergamo, built as a self-contained company town for textile workers. Industrialists designed it in the late 19th century to look after their employees' needs, and it survives remarkably intact. Today you can wander its streets of workers' houses, and parts of the site are still used for industry.
